description: Timed Hardcore turns hardcore multiplayer into something you can actually play with friends. When you die, you are not gone for good. You are locked out of the server for a configurable time or until the next fixed revival time of the day.

mods.name: Timed Hardcore
mods.description: Hardcore multiplayer where death is temporary: die and you are locked out for a set time instead of forever.

releases.notes:
## Death clips

Death messages in Discord can now show the **last 10 seconds before the death** as an animated GIF, ending on the death screen. Set `"deathMedia": "CLIP"` under `discord` in the config.

- Recorded by the dying player's own client (client mod required); players without it get the picture as before.
- Every player decides per server what to share: **World only**, **With HUD** or **Don't share**. A notice explains it when joining; the choice can be changed under *Edit* in the server list or in *World Options*.
- Nothing is written to disk. The kick waits until the clip is sent (usually a second or two, at most 60 seconds).

## Discord

- Separate webhooks for deaths and revivals (`deathWebhookUrl`, `revivalWebhookUrl`): one channel, two channels, or only one of them.
- New command `/timedhardcore discord [enable|disable]` to switch the messages off without removing the webhooks.
- Revival messages show how long the player was dead.
- Fixed: the picture sometimes showed the default skin instead of the player's.

## Your own time zone

Players with the client mod now see all times (revival, time of death, fixed revival times) in their own time zone: on the kick screen, in chat and in the graveyard. Without the mod, times show the server's time zone, e.g. `8:00 PM UTC`.

## Smaller changes

- The kick screen shows the full time of death, not the time left after the clip upload.
- The "is dead for" chat message appears right at the death.

## Upgrading from 1.1

- The config is converted automatically: the Discord settings move into `discord`, and the old webhook is used for both deaths and revivals.
- Server and client versions can be mixed. A 1.1 client on a 1.2 server works (no clips, server time zone), and so does a 1.2 client on a 1.1 server.
- Requirements are unchanged: Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API, Java 25.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Laubfrosch49/minecraft-timed-hardcore/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

releases.notes:
## Discord notifications

Timed Hardcore can now post every timed death and every revival to a Discord channel through a webhook.

- **Death**: the player's name and head, the cause of death, how long they stay dead and when they come back, with a full-body picture of the player in **black and white**.
- **Revival**: who is back, who revived them, how long they were dead and what killed them, with the picture in **colour**.
- The time of revival is a Discord timestamp: everyone sees it in their own time zone, with a live countdown.
- Pictures include the player's cape and come from [NMSR](https://nmsr.nickac.dev/) by default. Any other render service can be configured.
- Mentions are disabled, so a mob named `@everyone` pings nobody.
- Messages are sent in the background, the server never waits for Discord. Failed messages are retried up to three times.

### Setup

1. In Discord: *Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL*
2. Paste it into `config/timed-hardcore.json`:
   ```json
   "discordWebhookUrl": "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..."
